title: Akamai WAF connector (Beta)
body:
The Akamai WAF connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

The connector ingests web application firewall (WAF) security events from Akamai into Databricks. Authentication uses Akamai EdgeGrid API client credentials.

See [Akamai WAF connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/akamai-waf).
